bethel_organist.text: Shhh, I am tuning. The organ sulks if it is rushed.
Bethel is Hebrew for house of God. Welsh chapels often took their names from the Bible, Zion, Salem and Bethel.
This valley sings. Llangollen holds an International Musical Eisteddfod every July. It began in 1947.
It started to bring people from the war-torn world together through music. A fine thing to do with a song.

then.text: Rhodri Pugh, conductor of Cor y Dyffryn, three times runner-up and counting.
Did I say I would happily see that Chair in the Dee? I say that about everything. The shield, the raffle, a game of dominoes on Tuesday.
Wherever it is, I haven't got it. I've got a choir, a cold and a grudge, and not one of them is chair-shaped.
